svg.text: Desk Bike controller on an 830-point breadboard — ESP32-DevKitC V4, MOSFET H-bridge, RJ45 harness, OLED/encoder cable
bottom rail: − = GND + = 5 V (both rails joined at column 63)
Wire list (one line per jumper; ESP pins are the single free hole in row j above each header pin)
ESP 3V3 (j20) → j22 (3V3 bus = column 22, rows f–i free)
top rail + ↔ bottom rail +, top − ↔ bottom − (col 63)
C1 470 µF (+ to + rail) col 24; C3 100 nF col 53; both across bottom rail
e25 ↔ e29, d29 ↔ d35 (node D) · e26 ↔ e30 (OUT_A) · a27 → + rail · a31, a33 → − rail
R1 470 a25 → + rail · R2 1k c34 ↔ c36 · R3 10k a36 → − rail · IN1: ESP GPIO18 (col 12, jumper seated in e12 under the module) → e36
e40 ↔ e44, d44 ↔ d50 (node D) · e41 ↔ e45 (OUT_B) · a42 → + rail · a46, a48 → − rail
R4 470 a40 → + rail · R5 1k c49 ↔ c51 · R6 10k a51 → − rail · IN2: ESP GPIO19 (col 13, jumper in e13 under the module) → e51
OUT_A d30 → RJ45 pin 4 (blue, col 57) · OUT_B d45 → RJ45 pin 5 (white/blue, col 58) · C2 100 nF g57 ↔ g58 (across the motor pins)
pin 1 white/orange (pot GND) → − rail · pin 3 white/green (chassis GND) → − rail · pin 7 white/brown (reed return) → − rail
pin 2 orange (wiper) → ESP GPIO34 (j16) · pin 6 green (pot supply) → 3V3 bus f22 · pin 8 brown (reed) → ESP GPIO27 (j10)
VCC → 3V3 bus g22 · GND → − rail · SDA → GPIO21 (col 15, jumper in e15 under the module) · SCL → GPIO22 (col 18, e18)
A → GPIO16 (col 9, e9) · B → GPIO17 (col 10, e10) · PSH → GPIO25 (j12) · BAK → GPIO26 (j11) · CON → GPIO33 (j13)
Pin map is the committed one in desk-bike.yaml. DevKitC pins sit in rows i and a; row j is the only free hole beside the 3V3-side header.
For the other header (16, 17, 18, 19, 21, 22) seat a jumper in hole e of that column BEFORE pressing the module in; it runs under the board (dashed) and exits at the channel.
Optional: 100 nF from i16 (GPIO34) to the − rail if the harness runs over the 6 ft Cat-6 extension.
